Paragraph: In Bhagavad Gita Chapter 12, Verse 15, Krishna describes his cherished devotee: 'He by whom no one is agitated and who is not agitated by anyone, who is free from joy, envy, fear, and anxiety—he is very dear to Me.'
Situation/Problem_Faced: Interpersonal friction, social anxiety, provocation, and emotional volatility caused by social interactions.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Krishna advocates a harmless, peaceful presence, encouraging non-reactivity to social triggers and emotional peacefulness.
Outcome/Resolution: Building harmonious, non-reactive relationships creates social peace and personal calm.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Ahimsa (Non-harming in speech, thought, and action)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: True spiritual life means being a source of peace to others while keeping one's own mind undisturbed.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Highlights healthy boundaries, non-reactive communication, and interpersonal effectiveness.
